summary.en: This release revises the public observatory website with clearer, more direct explanations of the observing journey and its scientific foundations.
summary.zh: 本次更新重新整理了天文台官网文案，以更直接的方式介绍观测旅程及其科学原理。

items.en: The opening, Maya introduction, telescope assembly, optics, observing and instrument sections now use shorter and more specific language.
items.zh: 首页开场、Maya 介绍、望远镜组装、光学、观测与仪器章节已改用更简洁、明确的表述。

items.en: Dense promotional passages were removed or rewritten so the page reads more like an observatory guide than generic marketing copy.
items.zh: 部分冗长的宣传性段落已经删除或重写，让页面更接近天文台指南，而不是泛化的宣传文案。

items.en: Desktop and mobile layouts were checked against the longer technical explanations to prevent clipped cards and unreadable overflow.
items.zh: 桌面端和移动端均已针对较长的技术说明完成排版检查，避免卡片裁切或文字溢出。

items.en: The dark-adaptation explanation now correctly describes the increasing sensitivity of rod cells, while focus, chromatic aberration, seeing and tracking terminology has been clarified.
items.zh: 暗适应说明现已正确描述视杆细胞敏感度的恢复，同时进一步明确了调焦、色差、视宁度和跟踪等术语。

footer.en: Thank you for helping the observatory speak with greater clarity.
footer.zh: 感谢你帮助天文台把每一句话说得更清楚。
